'''Marta Irene Litter''' (born 3 August 1946) is Latin American chemist who is a professor at [[National University of General San Martín]] and the [[CONICET]] of [[Argentina]]. She is a member of [[The World Academy of Sciences]] and the Latin American Academy of Sciences. 

== Early life and education ==
Litter was an undergraduate and graduate student in [[Buenos Aires]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Litter, Marta Irene|url=https://twas.org/directory/litter-marta-irene|access-date=2021-10-25|website=TWAS|language=en}}</ref> She moved to the [[University of Arizona]] as a postdoctoral researcher in 1983.<ref name=":0" /> 

== Research and career ==
Litter studies the presence and transformation of chemical species in environmental matrices, such as water, air and soil. These include the presence of [[arsenic]] in waters in Latin America, which is known to cause damage to human health.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Litter|first1=Marta Irene|last2=Hernández|first2=María Aurora Armienta|last3=Villanueva-Estrada|first3=Ruth Esther|last4=Lepori|first4=Edda C. Villaamil|last5=Olmos|first5=Valentina|date=2019-11-29|title=Arsenic in Latin America|url=http://www.scirevfew.net/index.php/sciencereviews/article/view/8|journal=Science Reviews: From the End of the World|language=en|volume=1|issue=1|pages=54–73|doi=10.52712/sciencereviews.v1i1.8|s2cid=243622185|issn=2683-9288|doi-access=free|hdl=11336/124182|hdl-access=free}}</ref> It is estimated that over 14 million people in Latin America are at risk of high concentrations of arsenic, which can give rise to skin disorders.<ref>{{Cite web|title=One Century of the Discovery of Arsenicosis in Latin America (1914-2014) As2014: Proceedings of the 5th International Congress on Arsenic in the Environment, May 11-16, 2014, Buenos Aires, Argentina|url=https://www.routledge.com/One-Century-of-the-Discovery-of-Arsenicosis-in-Latin-America-1914-2014/Litter-Nicolli-Meichtry-Quici-Bundschuh-Bhattacharya-Naidu/p/book/9781138372634|access-date=2021-10-25|website=Routledge & CRC Press|language=en}}</ref> She makes use of thermal and photochemical analytical and removal techniques.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ganadores del Premio Dr. Eduardo Charreau 2021 – RICYT|date=17 June 2021 |url=http://www.ricyt.org/2021/06/titulo-ganadores-del-premio-dr-eduardo-charreau-2021/|access-date=2021-10-25|language=es-ES}}</ref> She has concentrated her research on the development of heterogenous photocalaysis. These catalysts can be used to convert ionic species to metallic solids, which allows them to be deposited across the surface of a semiconductor and permits them to be converted into a less toxic form.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|date=2020-08-29|title=Webinar on Catalysis and Chemical Science|url=https://irisscientificgroup.com/conferences/catalysis-and-chemical-science/webinar/uploads/images/Program_Webinar.pdf.pdf}}</ref> Three distinct mechanisms can be involved with the photocatalytic removal of metal ions from water, the reduction of photogenerated electrons, indirect reduction by intermediates and oxidative removal.<ref name=":1" /> 

Litter was appointed to [[The World Academy of Sciences]] in 2019 and the Latin American Academy of Sciences in 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Litter, Marta ingles|url=https://iiia.conicet.gov.ar/?post_type=page&p=1968|access-date=2021-10-25|language=es}}</ref> In 2021, Litter was made the inaugural 'Academic Leader' award winner of the Latin American Women in Chemistry Awards.<ref>{{Cite web|title=New award honors Latin American women in science|url=https://cen.acs.org/people/awards/New-award-honors-Latin-American-women-in-science/99/i39|access-date=2021-10-25|website=Chemical & Engineering News|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=PREMIO MUJERES LATINO AMERICANAS EN QUÍMICA 2021|url=https://cen.acs.org/sections/premios-latinoamericanas.html|access-date=2021-10-25|website=cen.acs.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Professora da Unesp é uma das vencedoras do Premio Mujeres Latinoamericanas en Química 2021|url=https://agencia.fapesp.br/professora-da-unesp-e-uma-das-vencedoras-do-premio-mujeres-latinoamericanas-en-quimica-2021/37120/|access-date=2021-10-25|website=AGÊNCIA FAPESP|language=pt}}</ref> Later that year she was awarded the Eduardo Charreau Award.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|title=Académico de Ingeniería UC es reconocido con el Premio Dr. Eduardo Charreau|url=https://www.ing.uc.cl/noticias/academico-de-ingenieria-uc-es-reconocido-con-el-premio-dr-eduardo-charreau/|access-date=2021-10-25|website=Ingeniería UC|language=en}}</ref> In 2023 she was granted the Platinum [[Konex Award]] as the most important chemist in Argentina.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-10-02 |title=El listado completo de los científicos distinguidos con los premios Konex de Brillante y Platino |url=https://www.infobae.com/salud/ciencia/2023/10/02/el-listado-completo-de-los-cientificos-distinguidos-con-los-premios-konex-de-brillante-y-platino/ |access-date=2023-10-04 |website=infobae |language=es-ES}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Marta Litter {{!}} Fundación Konex |url=https://www.fundacionkonex.org/b5464-marta-litter |access-date=2023-10-04 |website=www.fundacionkonex.org |language=es}}</ref>
